releases.notes:
Changes since `v0.20.3`:

## Actions Required Before Upgrading

### (No, really, you MUST read this before you upgrade)

- **Minor releases:** Review the `.0` release notes for each new minor version you cross; see: [`v0.19.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.0), [`v0.20.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.0).
- **Patch releases:** Review the patch release notes leading up to this version, but *only* within this minor release line; see: [`v0.20.1`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.1), [`v0.20.2`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.2), [`v0.20.3`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.3).

- Observability: Updated logging for scheduler, flavor-assignment, and preemption. Scheduler per-Workload messages stay at verbosity level 2 by default and move to level 3 when the LogLevelForSchedulerMainLoop feature gate is enabled. The "Workload skipped from admission" message moved from level 0 to level 2, or 3 with the gate.
  
  If your dashboards, alerts or log queries depend on Kueue log messages, keys or verbosity levels,
  review them before upgrading. For the complete list of logging changes, see https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/17746. If you enable the LogLevelForSchedulerMainLoop feature gate, set the log level to 3 or higher to keep the scheduler's per-Workload messages. (#17835, @mimowo)
 
## Changes by Kind

### Bug or Regression

- CLI: Fixed the usage line of `kueuectl delete workload` to show that it accepts multiple names, that names and `--all` are mutually exclusive, and that `--all-namespaces` works only with `--all`. (#17924, @mbobrovskyi)
- DRA: Fixed a bug where CEL device availability checks counted devices from stale or incomplete ResourceSlice pools, so a Workload could reserve quota for devices the DRA allocator cannot use. (#17706, @junnhwan)
- DRA: Fixed a bug where Workloads whose device requests come from LimitRange defaults stayed pending after a matching DeviceClass was created. (#17864, @weizhoublue)
- DynamicQuotaOrchestrator: Prevent stale CapacityProvider synchronization status from driving effective-capacity computation after provider specification updates. (#17709, @Om-Beast)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where `WaitForPodsReady` could treat an elastic batch Job as not ready while a replacement Workload slice was pending admission. Kueue now evaluates readiness against the granted replica count in the latest admitted slice. (#17816, @mszadkow)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where an admitted elastic Workload could be evicted with `PodsReadyTimeout` while its scale-up Workload slice waited for quota, even after its Pods became ready. Kueue now updates `PodsReady` on the admitted Workload slice. (#17765, @kevin85421)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where, with `SchedulingEquivalenceHashing` enabled, a replacement workload slice that fits could be deferred because another replacement slice with the same requests did not fit. (#17682, @Narwhal-fish)
- FairSharing: Fixed a bug where a workload could be blocked from reclaiming its parent Cohort's nominal quota when that Cohort's DominantResourceShare was inflated by borrowing on an unrelated flavor. The nominal-quota preemption claim is now evaluated at the level where the preemptor's and target's subtrees meet, so descendants of a Cohort get preferential access to the Cohort's own nominal quota, and a ClusterQueue within its own nominal quota no longer preempts across a borrowing parent Cohort. (#17798, @amitaekbote)
- Job integrations: Fixed a bug where a job created right after its namespace could stay suspended without a Workload until the next informer resync. (#17843, @Narwhal-fish)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where the workloads dashboard, cohort, ClusterQueue, and ResourceFlavor websockets could push live updates when a related resource changed, even if the caller lacked cluster-wide watch permission for that resource. Callers without that permission still receive the initial snapshot filtered by their list permissions. (#17755, @HarshithaMS005)
- KueueViz: Fixed the workload owner reference always showing "N/A". (#17667, @onkar717)
- MultiKueue & LeaderWorkerSet: Fixed a bug where finishing, preempting, or scaling down one group of a LeaderWorkerSet deleted the LeaderWorkerSet on the worker cluster, stopping and recreating the other groups still running there. Kueue now deletes the remote LeaderWorkerSet only after its last group is removed from the worker. (#17644, @henry3260)
- MultiKueue: Fix a bug where a gated manager Pod kept the status copied from the worker Pod after its workload was evicted on the worker and requeued. (#17738, @marina-gonzalez-alvarez)
- MultiKueue: Immediately resynchronize workloads when a worker watch reconnects instead of waiting for the next polling interval. (#17845, @Kunal241207)
- Observability: Fixed a bug where, with the `CustomMetricLabels` feature gate enabled and a custom label taken from Workloads, a Workload deleted or relabeled right after admission could keep its stored label values in memory, or leave `kueue_admitted_active_workloads` and `kueue_local_queue_admitted_active_workloads` at -1 for its old label values and +1 for the new ones. (#17868, @thc1006)
- RayCluster: Added the Alpha RayClusterHeadPodReady feature gate, disabled by default. Enable it to use head readiness for PodsReady checks so unready workers do not block readiness of a usable head. Enabling this feature requires KubeRay v1.3.0 or later. (#17603, @kevin85421)
- Scheduler: Fixed a bug where a PodSet total past the largest Quantity was stored in `resourceUsage` as MaxInt64. The cache then under-counted that usage, and an even Pod count made the admission webhook reject the Workload on every retry. Kueue now records a total that fits in a Quantity, and sets `QuotaReserved=False` with reason `UnrecordableResourceUsage` when the total cannot be stored. (#17665, @HarshithaMS005)
- TAS: Fix feasible elastic Workload slice replacements being rejected during preemption because the predecessor's topology usage was counted twice. (#17792, @gola)
- TAS: Fixed a bug that could prevent grouped PyTorchJob and JobSet pods submitted through AppWrapper from receiving index-based topology placement when no pod index offset was set. Kueue now applies the default offset. (#17954, @weizhoublue)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where Pods of Kubeflow Jobs (v1), such as PyTorchJob, and of MPIJobs without `runLauncherAsWorker` in a `kueue.x-k8s.io/podset-group-name` PodSet group were ungated without rank ordering, and the topology ungater logged an error on every reconcile. Kueue now sets `kueue.x-k8s.io/pod-index-offset: "0"` on their grouped Pod templates when it starts the job. This applies to workloads admitted after the upgrade. (#17730, @henry3260)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where Pods of a TrainJob in a `kueue.x-k8s.io/podset-group-name` PodSet group were ungated without rank ordering, and the topology ungater logged an error on every reconcile. Kueue now sets `kueue.x-k8s.io/pod-index-offset: "0"` on these Pods when it starts the TrainJob. This applies to workloads admitted after the upgrade. (#17871, @henry3260)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where a Workload with multiple PodSets reported an empty (Pending) QuotaReserved reason when one PodSet needed preemption for quota and another failed topology placement even on an empty cluster. The topology failure is now reported as TopologyPlacementFailed. (#17617, @mimowo)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where an MPIJob with `runLauncherAsWorker` that set `kueue.x-k8s.io/pod-index-offset` alongside `kueue.x-k8s.io/podset-group-name` was admitted but never started, while holding quota. Kueue now accepts `"1"`, which matches the offset implied by the PodSet group, and rejects other values; remove the annotation from existing MPIJobs that use another value. (#17666, @henry3260)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where the `Active` condition message of a ClusterQueue listed TAS flavors without a Topology in a random order, which could cause repeated status updates of the ClusterQueue. The flavors are now listed in name order. (#17913, @spicysharkco)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where the pending message of a Workload with several PodSets that could not be placed could name a different PodSet in each scheduling cycle. Kueue now reports the first failed PodSet in alphabetical order. (#17624, @henry3260)

releases.notes:
Changes since `v0.20.2`:

## Actions Required Before Upgrading

### (No, really, you MUST read this before you upgrade)

- **Minor releases:** Review the `.0` release notes for each new minor version you cross; see: [`v0.19.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.0), [`v0.20.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.0).
- **Patch releases:** Review the patch release notes leading up to this version, but *only* within this minor release line; see: [`v0.20.1`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.1), [`v0.20.2`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.20.2).

## Changes by Kind

### Feature

- MultiKueue: Added support for RayService in-tree autoscaling on worker clusters using elastic workload slices. Requires the MultiKueueRayInTreeAutoscaling feature gate. (#17466, @kevin85421)
- Scheduling: Improved classical preemption performance by reusing candidate ordering and generating candidates on demand. Enable it with the alpha ClassicalPreemptionCandidateOrderCache feature gate (disabled by default). (#17296, @zhengchenyu)

### Bug or Regression

- ConcurrentAdmission: Fixed a bug where a parent `Workload` could remain admitted on a flavor removed from its `ClusterQueue` when a surviving variant was already admitted. The parent is now marked for eviction so it can be re-admitted on a remaining flavor. (#17337, @yuluo-yx)
- DRA: Fixed a bug where a workload requesting a DeviceClass by its implicit extended resource name `deviceclass.resource.kubernetes.io/<class>` was treated as an ordinary extended resource, so its quota was not charged to the `deviceClassMappings` logical resource and the workload could stay pending. (#17434, @henry3260)
- Deployment, StatefulSet & LeaderWorkerSet: Fixed a bug where, once a WorkloadPriorityClass named `default` existed, updates to an object with ready replicas and no `kueue.x-k8s.io/priority-class` label were rejected, even when Kueue did not manage the object. Kueue no longer adds the default WorkloadPriorityClass to such objects on update. (#17309, @henry3260)
- Elastic workloads: Fixed Pods remaining Pending after scale-up when ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlicesForProvisioningRequests is enabled. ProvisioningRequests belonging to a replaced workload slice are now retained while their capacity bookings remain valid. (#17359, @neilb-dotcom)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where an elastic Workload replacement slice that grows one PodSet and shrinks another could remain pending when the growing PodSet appeared before the shrinking PodSet in `spec.podSets`. (#17561, @abhayjoshi201)
- Fixed a bug where setting a ClusterQueue's `stopPolicy` to `HoldAndDrain` did not evict admitted Workloads whose LocalQueue was held or deleted. (#17480, @henry3260)
- Jobs: Fixed a bug where a Job could adopt an unrelated, already finished prebuilt Workload and run without quota management. Kueue now stops the Job instead. (#16994, @bolubo)
- KueueViz: Fix the workload details page failing when the Workload's LocalQueue was deleted. (#17275, @onkar717)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where a backend component failure could prevent graceful HTTP server shutdown. KueueViz now shuts down the server and stops the components before reporting the failure. (#17471, @fat-catTW)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where an unknown KUEUEVIZ_AUTH_MODE value could start the backend without authentication and authorization middleware. KueueViz now exits with an error unless the value is Disabled or TokenReview. (#17311, @fat-catTW)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where distinct user group or extra attribute sets could incorrectly share a cached authorization result. (#17408, @fat-catTW)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where the cohorts list exposed ClusterQueue names to users without permission to list ClusterQueues. (#17300, @henry3260)
- KueueViz: Fixed links to missing ClusterQueues and Cohorts, such as "N/A" on the dashboard linking to `/cluster-queue/undefined`. (#17405, @onkar717)
- KueueViz: Fixed the ResourceFlavor detail page always showing "None" for node labels and node taints. (#17329, @onkar717)
- KueueViz: Fixed the dashboard tooltip of a preempted workload not linking to the preemptor workload. (#17428, @onkar717)
- LeaderWorkerSet: Fixed a bug where changing the `kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name` label while no replica was Ready, but a Workload already held a quota reservation, made the LeaderWorkerSet reconciler fail on every retry and left the Workload in the old queue. Kueue now rejects the change in that case. (#17307, @Andrushika)
- MultiKueue: Fixed a bug where `serveConfigV2` updates to a RayService with in-tree autoscaling were not propagated to the worker cluster when `MultiKueueRayInTreeAutoscaling` was enabled. (#17513, @kevin85421)
- MultiKueue: Fixed a regression where `MultiKueueOrchestratedPreemption`, enabled by default since v0.20, added two status writes for every Workload replicated to a worker cluster, reducing MultiKueue admission throughput. `status.preemptionGates` no longer lists a `Closed` state for gates that have not been opened; such gates remain closed. (#17468, @YQ-Wang)
- MultiKueue: Fixed batch/Job re-dispatch eviction loop caused by status.failed counter rejection on Kubernetes 1.35+. (#17569, @mishradwaterlaw)
- MultiKueue: Fixed manager startup failure when the MultiKueueClusterProfile feature gate is enabled but the ClusterProfile CRD is not installed. (#17228, @yindia)
- Observability: Fixed `kueue_local_queue_admitted_active_workloads` doubling after a ClusterQueue custom label change, and going negative after a LocalQueue label change. (#17435, @Andrushika)
- Observability: Improved Workload controller logging:
  - Log Workload inadmissibility and recovery from DRA validation errors at verbosity 3, after the corresponding status update succeeds. DRA validation failures no longer produce error logs on every reconcile.
  - Move routine per-Workload messages from verbosity 2 to 3 or higher to reduce log noise.
  - Rename the `queue` and `prevQueue` log keys to `localQueue` and `prevLocalQueue`, and include the namespace in LocalQueue references.
  - Identify the failed operation in reconciliation errors. If updating the Workload status after a DRA failure also fails, report both errors.
  
  DRA: Fixed a case where a Workload kept `Requeued=True` after DRA validation failed again. The controller now sets `Requeued=False` even if the same validation error is already recorded in the Workload status. (#17332, @mimowo)
- Pod integration: Fixed a bug where a pod group's new Workload could be built from a pod still terminating on a node, pinning it there so it could not be admitted. The fix is on by default through the Beta `FinalizeTerminatingPodGroups` feature gate. (#17501, @anguszzzz)
- RayCluster: Fixed a bug where worker PodSet counts could fall below KubeRay’s minimum replica count, leaving workers scheduling-gated when capacity became available. Kueue now respects worker replica bounds when calculating PodSet counts. (#17366, @kevin85421)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug that could delay workload admission after leader failover when the new leader lacked Cohort quota. Kueue now keeps Cohorts in the scheduler cache on every replica. (#17404, @dundysm)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where every Workload event built the Workload's effective resources and scheduling hash for the DRA check even when no DeviceClass backs an extended resource, and compared whole PodSpecs to detect resource defaults, adding avoidable CPU overhead to the Workload controller. (#17444, @sohankunkerkar)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where fair-sharing preemption could repeatedly evict and re-admit Workloads when a preemptor was within nominal quota for one requested resource but still borrowing another. (#17349, @fat-catTW)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where the scheduler cache could drop an admitted Workload when its admission write was committed but the client observed an error, such as a timeout. This left the ClusterQueue's usage under-counted until the Workload's next update. (#17474, @kaushik229)
- StatefulSet: Fixed a bug where scaling a StatefulSet to zero released its Workload's quota while its Pods were still running, which could let other Workloads be admitted onto resources still in use. (#17540, @gola)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where Pods in a PodSet group whose indexes start from 0, such as JobSet or Ray workers, were ungated without rank ordering, which could split a `kueue.x-k8s.io/podset-slice-required-topology` slice across topology domains. This applies to workloads admitted after the upgrade. (#17512, @henry3260)

In a ClusterQueue with a `pods` quota, a PodSet whose Pods request no resources can now be admitted. (#17327, @thc1006)

- TAS: Fixed a bug where replacing a failed node never completed for a Workload with some Pods already succeeded, leaving the recreated Pod gated. Kueue now keeps the admitted Pod count and resource usage when it updates the topology assignment. (#17502, @Narwhal-fish)

## Changes by Kind

### Feature

- KueueViz: The workloads dashboard now shows the Pods of pod group Workloads, including StatefulSet and LeaderWorkerSet Workloads. (#17186, @henry3260)

### Bug or Regression

- CLI: Fixed a bug that caused kueuectl create clusterqueue to reject quota specifications with hyphenated resource names. Kueue now accepts these resource names. (#16987, @Dasmat13)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl list workload` failed with "resource name may not be empty" when a pending Workload had no `spec.queueName`. Such Workloads are now listed with empty LocalQueue and ClusterQueue columns. (#16986, @tenzen-y)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl version` printed only the client version, without the controller manager image, when Kueue was installed with Helm under a release name other than `kueue`. (#16953, @Eason09053360)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where kueuectl list workload --for could list workloads more than once when a paginated job-UID search ended with an empty page. (#17084, @Huangpinhan)
- CLI: Skip remote ClusterQueue lookup in create localqueue when using --dry-run=client. (#17109, @Dasmat13)
- Configuration: Fixed the `admissionFairSharing.usageSamplingInterval` and `admissionFairSharing.resourceWeights` validation errors to report the value at the field they name. (#16943, @thc1006)
- DRA: Fixed a bug where a Workload updated while the scheduler was processing it could be requeued with quota charges computed for its previous spec, causing over- or under-admission. - ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where an admission retry could cause a zero-count PodSet to lose a suitable flavor and block later scale-up. Kueue now selects a suitable flavor across retries. (#17107, @prash2512)
- FairSharing: Fixed the preemption bug where workloads within nominal quota were preempted if the ClusterQueue borrowed on an uncontested flavor or within an internal sub-cohort. (#17031, @akshat-lakhera)
- JobSet: Fixed a bug where an evicted Workload could keep its quota reserved, and was not requeued, if a JobSet restart had recreated child Jobs that had already succeeded. (#17215, @MaysaMacedo)
- KueueViz: Fix the workload Status column showing the first condition type instead of the workload status. (#17191, @onkar717)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where the backend HTTP server could hang indefinitely during graceful shutdown if active HTTP requests did not complete. The server now enforces a 30-second shutdown timeout. (#17198, @fat-catTW)
- KueueViz: Fixed indefinite loading on the Local Queues, Cluster Queues, Cohorts, and Resource Flavors pages when no resources are found. (#17175, @weizhoublue)
- KueueViz: The namespaces websocket now only provides LocalQueue-backed live updates to users with cluster-wide watch access to LocalQueues. Users without that permission still receive the initial namespace snapshot filtered by their list permissions. (#17180, @fat-catTW)
- Observability: Fixed a bug where `kueue_cluster_queue_weighted_share` and `kueue_replaced_workload_slices_total` kept reporting a deleted ClusterQueue, and `kueue_cluster_queue_weighted_share` kept a stale series with the old `cohort` label after a ClusterQueue moved to another Cohort. (#17239, @tenzen-y)
- Observability: Fixed a bug where custom-label updates to a ClusterQueue or LocalQueue could leave stale metric gauge series in Prometheus. (#17219, @akshat-lakhera)
- Observability: Fixed a bug where deleting a ClusterQueue could remove the `kueue_cohort_subtree_quota` and `kueue_cohort_subtree_resource_reservations` series of its Cohort while other ClusterQueues or child Cohorts remained in it. (#16941, @henry3260)
- Pod, AppWrapper & Kubeflow Jobs: Fixed a bug where changing the `kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name` label of a suspended job to an invalid LocalQueue name was accepted, so the Workload could not move to the new queue and the job reconciler failed on every retry. Kueue now rejects the update. (#16972, @tenzen-y)
- Pod: Avoid counting a terminating Pod's deletion grace period twice when deciding whether its PodGroup still holds quota. (#17077, @gola)
- Pod: Fixed a bug where, with `SkipReassignmentForPodOwnedWorkloads` enabled, a Workload owned by a single Pod that was preempted or evicted due to node failures while its Pod was still scheduling-gated (for example while an AdmissionCheck was pending) stayed parked with `Requeued=False` forever and its Pod was never deleted. - Pods: Fixed a bug where a Pod could bypass ClusterQueue quota by setting the kueue.x-k8s.io/role-hash annotation to another role's value and running an oversized Pod under that role's reservation. - RayService: Fixed webhook validation errors referencing `spec.rayClusterSpec` instead of the actual API field `spec.rayClusterConfig`. (#17097, @cryo-zd)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug that could prevent ClusterQueues in the same tree from requeueing workloads when quota became available after a Cohort cycle was resolved. (#17079, @henry3260)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where a Workload that needed to borrow quota could not preempt Workloads in its own ClusterQueue, even when withinClusterQueue allowed preemption. Kueue now preempts those Workloads. (#17010, @zhengchenyu)
- SparkApplication: Fixed a bug where a SparkApplication without `spec.executor.instances` could not be suspended when its Workload was evicted or deactivated, because Kueue wrote back an invalid `instances: 0`. (#16968, @tenzen-y)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where a workload with non-adjacent PodSet group members (for example, a JobSet) could start with another PodSet's labels and node selectors, leaving some Pods scheduling-gated. (#17089, @apullo777)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where topology preemption could exclude workloads on overlapping TAS flavors, even when removing them could make the incoming workload fit. With `TASHandleOverlappingFlavors` enabled, Kueue now considers those workloads as candidates. (#16919, @Nilsachy)
- TAS: Fixed a bug with `FlavorFungibilityPreserveScanProgress` enabled where workloads using `TryNextFlavor` could repeatedly retry a topology-blocked `ResourceFlavor` or skip viable borrowing flavors across scheduling cycles when all flavors required borrowing or when a later flavor had nominal quota. (#17070, @j-skiba)
- TAS: Improved required-topology placement failure messages to identify the required level and explain that all Pods must fit in a single topology domain. (#17172, @HasonoCell)
- Workload: Fixed the validation message shown when changing `spec.maximumExecutionTimeSeconds` on an admitted Workload to say "immutable while the workload is admitted" instead of "while workload quota reserved". (#16946, @thc1006)
- Workload: Reject negative Pod overhead when WorkloadValidateResourcesAreNonNegative is enabled. (#17201, @nareshpatel1015)

releases.notes:
Changes since `v0.20.0`:

## Actions Required Before Upgrading

### (No, really, you MUST read this before you upgrade)

### Feature

- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where elastic Pods ungated for a ProvisioningRequest could carry the consume-provisioning-request annotation without provisioning-class-name when they were created before the job template was stamped. Kueue now applies both annotations, preventing such Pods from being pinned by the cluster autoscaler to nodes that are never created. (#16543, @neilb-dotcom)

### Bug or Regression

- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl create clusterqueue` failed with "must match the name in coveredResources" when flavors listed the same resources in a different order, for example `--nominal-quota "alpha:cpu=1;memory=1,beta:memory=2;cpu=2"`. (#16544, @Eason09053360)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl delete workload` deleted the owning batch/v1 Job but left its Pods running and the Workload in place. Owners are now deleted with background propagation, matching `kubectl delete`. (#16511, @Eason09053360)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where a replacement Workload could remain pending when one PodSet shrank below its predecessor's grant while another grew. (#16892, @weizhoublue)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug where resizing an elastic job could let the scheduler admit workloads beyond a cohort's quota in the same scheduling cycle. With ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlicesWithTAS enabled, the replaced slice's topology usage no longer defers other workloads to the next scheduling cycle. (#16601, @apullo777)
- FairSharing: Fixed `kueue_cohort_weighted_share` to report `NaN` instead of `+Inf` when a zero-weight Cohort is borrowing quota, matching its help text and `kueue_cluster_queue_weighted_share`. (#16818, @abhayjoshi201)
- FairSharing: Fixed a bug where a ClusterQueue or Cohort whose weighted share exceeded the int64 range could report a negative `status.fairSharing.weightedShare`. Such a share is now reported as the int64 maximum. (#16592, @thc1006)
- FairSharing: Fixed a bug where a ClusterQueue or Cohort with weight 0 that borrowed only resources its Cohort had nothing lendable for got a weighted share of 0 instead of the maximum, and was ranked as if it were within its quota. (#16567, @thc1006)
- FairSharing: Fixed a bug where a borrowing ClusterQueue or Cohort with a very large weight, such as 1e308, could report a `status.fairSharing.weightedShare` of 0 and be ranked as if it were within its quota. Kueue now keeps such a share above zero: the status reports 1, and the `kueue_cluster_queue_weighted_share` and `kueue_cohort_weighted_share` metrics report the smallest positive float64 value. (#16584, @thc1006)
- FairSharing: Fixed a bug where restoring same-`ClusterQueue` workloads could make cross-`ClusterQueue` preemption targets violate fair-sharing rules and cause preemption loops. Kueue now validates targets against the final simulated post-admission state. (#16912, @JanKaczmarski)
- JobFramework: Fixed Workloads inheriting Kueue's internal labels and annotations from the Job or Pod when they were listed in labelKeysToCopy or as custom metric sources. (#16773, @thc1006)
- KueueViz: Fix the LocalQueue detail page missing the Status cell in the workloads table and returning null instead of an empty array for queues with no workloads. (#16692, @Dasmat13)
- KueueViz: Fix the workload detail page not showing the ClusterQueue name and preemption state. (#16608, @onkar717)
- KueueViz: Fixed a bug where the workloads dashboard listed unrelated Pods for Workloads without a `kueue.x-k8s.io/job-uid` label, such as pod groups. Such Workloads now show an empty Pods list. (#16702, @henry3260)

releases.name: v0.20.0
releases.notes:
Changes since `v0.19.0`:

## Actions Required Before Upgrading

### (No, really, you MUST read this before you upgrade)

- **Minor releases:** Review the `.0` release notes for each new minor version you cross; see: [`v0.18.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.18.0), [`v0.19.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.0).

- AFS: LocalQueue usage is now accounted from quota reservation rather than admission for ClusterQueues using UsageBasedAdmissionFairSharing. AdmissionFairSharingAnchorAtQuotaReservation is Beta and enabled by default in v0.20.
  
  If you explicitly disable AdmissionFairSharing, also disable AdmissionFairSharingAnchorAtQuotaReservation before upgrading to v0.20, or Kueue will reject the configuration at startup. Before rolling back to a release that does not recognize AdmissionFairSharingAnchorAtQuotaReservation, remove it from the configuration. (#15000, @apullo777)
 - API: Kueue no longer serves kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta1. 
  
  Update manifests and API clients to v1beta2 before upgrading. Run the [migration script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/main/hack/migrate-to-v1beta2.sh) before upgrading to rewrite existing objects in v1beta2 storage. (#14558, @mbobrovskyi)
 - DRA & ResourceTransformation: Fixed a bug where DRA device-class mapping or a resource transformation under the reserved resource name `pods` was silently discarded or left the Workload permanently pending.
  
  Remove or rename those entries before upgrading, or the kueue-controller-manager will fail to start. Renaming a mapping name or an `outputs` key also requires updating the matching ClusterQueue `nominalQuota` entries in the same change. (#13989, @thc1006)
 - DRA: Fixed missing quota charges for Pod overhead and transformation outputs that share a DRA resource name. Restartable init-container requests are now counted alongside regular-container requests. 
  
  Review ClusterQueue quotas for mapped logical resources and contributions still charged under original resource names. When both use one name, quota must cover their sum. With BlockUndeclared, uncovered contributions leave Workloads pending; with IgnoreUndeclared, they are not charged. Corrected accounting applies when Workloads are evaluated. (#14154, @thc1006)
 - KueueViz: Added Kubernetes RBAC checks through SubjectAccessReview for API and WebSocket requests when authentication is enabled.
  
  Ensure users have the get, list, and watch permissions needed for their views. For non-Helm or custom RBAC installations, ensure the backend ServiceAccount can create subjectaccessreviews in the authorization.k8s.io API group. The Helm chart includes this permission. (#13810, @mykysha)
 - LeaderWorkerSet: Fixed a quota bypass where raising `spec.leaderWorkerTemplate.size` on an already-admitted, Kueue-managed LeaderWorkerSet ran more pods per group than the reserved quota covered. `spec.leaderWorkerTemplate.size` is now immutable while the LeaderWorkerSet is managed by Kueue, behind the new `LWSImmutableGroupSize` feature gate (Beta, enabled by default). `spec.replicas` stays mutable.
  
  If you change `spec.leaderWorkerTemplate.size` on a Kueue-managed LeaderWorkerSet, recreate it at the new size instead, or disable the `LWSImmutableGroupSize` feature gate to keep the previous behavior, which also restores the quota bypass. (#13279, @ivnovakov)
 - Observability: Kueue now rejects invalid metrics.localQueueMetrics.localQueueSelector values at startup. Previously, enabled LocalQueue metrics included all queues when this selector was invalid.
  
  Correct invalid selectors before upgrading if metrics.localQueueMetrics.enable is true. (#16379, @weizhoublue)
 - RayService: Starting in v0.20, the Beta `RayServiceValidateUpgradeStrategy` feature gate is enabled by default.
  
  Kueue-managed RayServices that use zero-downtime upgrades must enable the `ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices` feature gate and set the `kueue.x-k8s.io/elastic-job` annotation to `"true"`. To disable zero-downtime upgrades, explicitly set `spec.upgradeStrategy.type` to `None`. (#16094, @kevin85421)
 - SparkApplication: Fixed a bug where Workloads reserved less CPU and memory than Spark requests for the driver and executor Pods, because `cores`, `memoryOverhead` and Spark's default memory overhead were ignored. Kueue now reserves the same CPU and memory that Spark requests. Memory values must use the Java format accepted by Spark (for example `512m` or `2g`); Kubernetes-style values such as `512Mi` are rejected.
  
  If SparkApplications rely on `cores` or on the default memory overhead, raise the ClusterQueue quotas accordingly: each Pod now reserves its `cores` as CPU and at least 384Mi of additional memory. (#15833, @henry3260)
 - TAS: Fix a bug where TASRecomputeAssignmentWithinSchedulingCycle can be enabled even if TopologyAwareScheduling is disabled.
  
  If you disable TopologyAwareScheduling, also set TASRecomputeAssignmentWithinSchedulingCycle=false before upgrading. (#14237, @tenzen-y)
 - TAS: Workload slice sizes must be positive, and podSetSliceRequiredTopology and podSetSliceSize must be set together. 
  
  Correct invalid manifests before upgrading. Disabling TASValidateWorkloadSliceSize disables only webhook checks; CRD minimum-size validation still applies. (#12728, @mszadkow)
 - TrainJob: support Trainer v2.3.
  
  If you use Trainer v2.2, you have to update it to v2.3 since Trainer v2.2 and v2.3 don't have API compatibility. (#14504, @SatishChoudhary642)
 - Workloads: Fixed a bug that caused Workloads to be finalized as orphaned while their owner Job was being deleted. Kueue now waits until the owner Job no longer exists before finalizing the Workload.
  
  If you implement the ComposableJob interface in a custom job integration, change your Load method to return (*jobframework.LoadResult, error) instead of (bool, error). Use jobframework.NewLoadResult(shouldFinalize, found) where found is false when the job is absent and true otherwise. (#12849, @mbobrovskyi)
 
## Changes by Kind

### API Change

- ConfigurablePreemptions: Added the alpha PreemptionConfig API for selecting additional Workloads to preempt when classical or Fair Sharing candidates are insufficient. Requires the ConfigurablePreemptions feature gate and alpha CRDs. (#15913, @danylott)
- PartialAdmission: Workload `PodSet.minCount` can now be set to `0`, allowing PodSets with zero replicas. Previously, `minCount` had to be at least `1`. (#14720, @vladikkuzn)
- TAS: Allowed mutating `Topology.spec.levels` when `kubernetes.io/hostname` is the lowest level both before and after the change. Workloads left pending under the previous levels are automatically retried, and the usage of already-admitted workloads is preserved across the change. (#13910, @tomsen02)
- TAS: Allowed updating `spec.nodeLabels` of a ResourceFlavor with `topologyName` set. Admitted workloads keep their quota reservation and topology assignment, pending workloads are requeued against the new node set, and usage of workloads admitted on overlapping flavors is counted exactly once. (#13738, @tomsen02)
- TAS: ResourceFlavor spec.tolerations can now be updated when spec.topologyName is set. (#13622, @tomsen02)

### Feature

- CLI: Added ACTIVE and REASON columns to wide output for ClusterQueue and LocalQueue resources. (#15633, @prash2512)
- CLI: Added an `ACTIVE` column and an `--active` flag to `kueuectl list localqueue`, allowing users to see and filter LocalQueues by whether they have an active connection to their ClusterQueue (`--active=true` for active, `--active=false` for inactive). (#15866, @henry3260)
- CLI: The importer mapping file now supports a `resources` list in the `match` block, selecting only the Pods that request a non-zero amount of all the listed resources. (#15573, @Huang-Wei)
- ClusterQueue: Graduated `RejectUpdatesToCQWithInvalidOnFlavors` to Beta (enabled by default), which rejects ClusterQueue updates that reference invalid ResourceFlavor names in `admissionCheckStrategy.onFlavors`. (#14776, @tenzen-y)
- ConcurrentAdmission: Increased the maximum number of `ResourceFlavors` per `ResourceGroup` from 16 to 32 for `ClusterQueues` with `ConcurrentAdmissionPolicy` configured. (#15949, @ResidentMario)
- Controllers: Increased the maximum concurrent API updates per reconcile from 8 to 32 via the `HighMaxParallelismWithinReconcile` feature gate (Beta, enabled by default in v0.20). (#16336, @olekzabl)
- DRA: Added `DeviceTaintRule` support to the `KueueDRADeviceFeasibility` device check, so Kueue no longer admits Workloads onto tainted devices. (#16081, @sohankunkerkar)
- DRA: Added the `KueueDRADeviceFeasibility` feature gate, Alpha and disabled by default. Kueue checks device availability per node before admitting a Workload that uses ResourceClaimTemplates or DRA-backed extended resources, so quota is not reserved for a Workload kube-scheduler cannot place. (#15577, @sohankunkerkar)
- DRA: Added the `KueueDRAIntegrationPrioritizedList` feature gate (alpha, disabled by default). When enabled, a DRA `firstAvailable` request whose alternatives all ask for the same device count on DeviceClasses mapped to one logical resource is charged that count once. A request whose alternatives differ in count or in logical resource, or use a counter-backed or capacity-backed mapping, is refused. Kueue does not check that any alternative is satisfiable, and MultiKueue does not support `firstAvailable` requests. (#14130, @thc1006)
- DRA: Device feasibility checks now include taints from ResourceSlices and DeviceTaintRules. A Workload’s device requests must tolerate these taints. Requires both the KueueDRAIntegrationDeviceTaints and KueueDRADeviceFeasibility feature gates. (#16169, @sohankunkerkar)
- DRA: Device requests with `adminAccess: true` are now accepted without DRA quota charges. Other resource requests are counted normally. (#13642, @sohankunkerkar)

## Changes by Kind

### Feature

- Controllers: Increased the maximum concurrent API updates per reconcile from 8 to 32. Controlled by the HighMaxParallelismWithinReconcile feature gate. (#16387, @mimowo)

### Bug or Regression

- AFS: Fixed a bug where workloads could be scheduled in priority order instead of fair-sharing order when Admission Fair Sharing was enabled. (#16307, @abhayjoshi201)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl list pods --for pod/NAME` printed `No resources found` instead of listing the group members, when the Pod group name was stored in the `kueue.x-k8s.io/pod-group-name` annotation rather than the label. (#16408, @tenzen-y)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `list pods --for pod/NAME` printed `No resources found` for a Pod that is not part of a pod group. The command now lists that Pod itself. (#16378, @tenzen-y)
- Cohorts: Fixed a possible controller hang after an invalid Cohort hierarchy cycle update. ClusterQueues in a cyclic Cohort now surface a clear `CohortCycleDetected` condition instead of hanging. (#16376, @tenzen-y)
- Helm: Fixed ServiceMonitor metrics scraping to verify the cert-manager-issued certificate when enableCertManager is true and no custom tlsConfig is set. (#16318, @HsiuChuanHsu)
- KueueViz: Fix Workloads page crash when no workloads exist by adding the missing Alert import. (#16396, @Dasmat13)
- LeaderWorkerSet & StatefulSet: Fixed a bug where, during a rolling update, Pods at the current revision were ungated before the Workload was admitted, so they could run without quota. Kueue now ungates these Pods only when the Workload is admitted. (#16401, @henry3260)
- LeaderWorkerSet: Fixed a bug where a rolling update with a percentage `maxSurge` (such as `50%`) had its surge groups' Workloads deleted while those groups were still running. The value was read as zero, so Kueue treated the update as having no surge. (#14405, @thc1006)
- MultiKueue: Fixed a bug where evicted elastic workloads left stale remote objects on worker clusters, preventing re-admission from the manager-cluster specification. (#16178, @kevin85421)
- MultiKueue: Fixed a bug where the quota automation condition could retain a stale ObservedGeneration after a ClusterQueue spec update. Kueue now refreshes it after successful evaluation. (#16403, @mbobrovskyi)
- Observability: Fixed Admitted events reporting 0s when quota was reserved before admission. Events now show the actual time between quota reservation and admission. (#16412, @tenzen-y)
- Observability: Fixed kueue_cohort_subtree_admitted_active_workloads after Cohort hierarchy changes so it reflects admitted Workloads in the current subtree. (#16437, @tenzen-y)
- Pod: Fixed a bug where Pod groups could receive different ResourceFlavor assignments depending on client-provided role-hash values. PodSets are now ordered by scheduling shape rather than role-hash, making flavor assignment deterministic. Controlled by the `PodGroupSchedulingShapeOrdering` feature gate (Beta, enabled by default). (#14809, @amirialy)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug that could leave workloads pending when preemption target selection omitted `pods` quota or used the spec count for a partially admitted workload-slice replacement. Kueue now sizes preemption targets using the assigned counts and resources. (#16200, @apullo777)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where preemption for workloads with non-adjacent members of a kueue.x-k8s.io/podset-group-name group could use incorrect resource requests or flavors, causing a scheduler panic or leaving a Workload pending. Kueue now matches PodSets by name. (#16273, @apullo777)
- StatefulSet: Fixed a bug where changing the `kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name` label after the Pods were ungated but before any was Ready made the StatefulSet reconciler fail on every retry, and could keep a Pod scheduling-gated during a rolling update. Kueue now only updates the queue name on Pods that are still gated. (#16335, @henry3260)

releases.notes:
Changes since `v0.19.5`:

## Actions Required Before Upgrading

### (No, really, you MUST read this before you upgrade)

- **Patch releases:** Review the patch release notes leading up to this version, but *only* within this minor release line; see: [`v0.19.1`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.1), [`v0.19.2`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.2), [`v0.19.3`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.3), [`v0.19.4`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.4), [`v0.19.5`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/tag/v0.19.5).

- DRA: Fixed a bug where a chargeable Pod overhead or a resource-transformation output that shared a name with a DRA-backed extended resource was taken back along with the DRA charge and dropped from quota accounting. Only the containers' own request is subtracted now, so any such contribution left under the original `extendedResourceName` after `excludeResourcePrefixes` and transformations is preserved. Also fixed a restartable init (sidecar) container being maxed against the total instead of added to it, so its devices are counted alongside the regular containers'.
  
  When a `deviceClassMappings` entry maps a DeviceClass to a different logical name, ClusterQueues must cover that logical name. A container-only request is fully translated and needs quota only on the logical name; cover the original `extendedResourceName` as well only if a Workload leaves chargeable Pod overhead or a resource-transformation output under it (normally in the same resource group). With such a residual uncovered, `BlockUndeclared` makes the Workload wait with the original name reported unavailable, while `IgnoreUndeclared` skips the residual and leaves it out of recorded usage. Where no mapping renames the DeviceClass, or the mapped name is the `extendedResourceName` itself, the device charge and the residual land on that one key, so its corrected usage can rise: a container asking for 1 with 1 of chargeable overhead now records 2 where it recorded 1. No second key is needed there, but the nominal quota has to cover the pair rather than a count of devices. The change applies as Workloads are evaluated, not to existing reservations at once. (#15987, @thc1006)
 - SparkApplication: Fixed a bug where Workloads reserved less CPU and memory than Spark requests for the driver and executor Pods, because `cores`, `memoryOverhead` and Spark's default memory overhead were ignored. Kueue now reserves the same CPU and memory that Spark requests. Memory values must use the Java format accepted by Spark (for example `512m` or `2g`); Kubernetes-style values such as `512Mi` are rejected.
  
  If SparkApplications rely on `cores` or on the default memory overhead, raise the ClusterQueue quotas accordingly: each Pod now reserves its `cores` as CPU and at least 384Mi of additional memory. (#15923, @henry3260)
 
## Changes by Kind

### Bug or Regression

- AppWrapper: Added editor and viewer ClusterRoles for AppWrappers (#16101, @HsiuChuanHsu)
- CLI: Fix kueuectl version to honor --namespace when looking up the controller manager image. (#15977, @DevaanshPathak)
- ConcurrentAdmission: Fix a panic that left a parent Workload without variants when its name contained no "-". (#15850, @rjgoyln)
- DRA: Fixed a bug where a Workload that had been marked inadmissible kept reporting Requeued=False with reason Inadmissible after its DRA resources were resolved, because the condition was only cleared in memory and never written back. Kueue now persists Requeued=True with reason DRAResourcesResolved. (#15959, @PannagaRao)
- Deployment: The Workload of a Deployment-managed Pod carries the Deployment UID in the `kueue.x-k8s.io/job-uid` label instead of the Pod UID. Gated by `DeploymentJobUIDLabel`, Alpha and disabled by default. (#16004, @rjgoyln)
- ElasticJobsViaWorkloadSlices: Fixed a bug that could assign an incompatible ResourceFlavor when an elastic Workload was re-admitted with zero pods. Kueue now selects a flavor that supports the Workload’s per-pod resource requirements. (#16078, @prash2512)
- FailureRecovery: Fixed a bug where, with the FailureRecoveryPolicy feature gate enabled, Kueue added a duplicate KueueFailureRecovery Pod condition and emitted a duplicate KueueForcefullyDeleted warning event
  every time it reconciled a Pod stuck in termination. Kueue now sets the condition once and emits the event only when the condition changes. (#16113, @ErikJiang)
- Fixed a bug where an evicted Workload for a StatefulSet or LeaderWorkerSet that had no Pods (for example, scaled to zero) kept its quota reserved, which blocked other Workloads in the ClusterQueue. Kueue now releases the reservation. (#16128, @gola)
- Job: Fixed a bug where a Job with `parallelism` greater than `completions` could release the quota of its still-running Pods once some Pods succeeded, allowing the ClusterQueue to admit Workloads beyond its quota. (#16132, @henry3260)
- Job: Reject partial-admission minimum parallelism values outside the int32 range. (#16002, @cryo-zd)
- MultiKueue: Fixed a bug that left `Active.ObservedGeneration` stale after a healthy configuration update. Kueue now records the latest evaluated generation. (#15989, @weizhoublue)
- Pod: Added the `PodIntegrationCountSucceededPodsAsReady` feature gate (Alpha, disabled by default). When enabled, succeeded pods count as ready for `PodsReady`, which fixes a bug where a pod group could be evicted after `waitForPodsReady.recoveryTimeout` once one of its pods completed. (#15910, @henry3260)
- ProvisioningRequest: Fixed a bug where a pre-existing `PodTemplate` at the deterministic name could be adopted verbatim, letting a user who can write `PodTemplate` objects decouple the capacity requested from Cluster Autoscaler from the quota-checked Workload PodSets. Kueue now replaces divergent specs with Kueue-derived contents. Gated by `EnforceProvisioningPodTemplateContents` (Alpha, disabled by default). (#16070, @vladikkuzn)
- RBAC: Fixed a bug where a subject bound to `kueue-batch-admin-role` had no access to `AdmissionCheck`, `MultiKueueCluster`, `MultiKueueConfig`, `ProvisioningRequestConfig` and `WorkloadPriorityClass` (#16032, @HsiuChuanHsu)
- Ray integrations: Reject Kueue-managed jobs whose head Pod template has no containers during admission. (#16084, @kevin85421)
- RayJob: Fixed a bug where a RayJob using the default submitter Job (`submissionMode: K8sJobMode` without `submitterPodTemplate`) and a head Pod template with no containers caused the Kueue webhook and reconciler to panic. Kueue now returns an error instead. (#16065, @henry3260)
- ResourceTransformations: Fixed a bug where excluding a transformation input could let a Workload bypass ClusterQueue quota accounting. Kueue now accounts for the transformed output. (#16053, @weizhoublue)
- SparkApplication: Fixed a bug where a SparkApplication that only set the SparkApplication-level `spec.nodeSelector` permanently lost it after the first eviction, letting the driver and executor pods be scheduled onto any node once re-admitted. The selector is now recorded in the Workload PodSets, so it also participates in ResourceFlavor matching. (#15797, @henry3260)
- StatefulSet: Fixed a bug that allowed invalid TAS annotations in StatefulSet updates when TopologyAwareScheduling is enabled. Kueue now validates TAS metadata during updates. (#16104, @thuongvu)
- TAS: Fix a bug where StatefulSet integration didn't validate pod template metadata for topology annotations. (#15881, @weizhoublue)
- TAS: Fixed a bug that could cause workload admission to fail with topology level not specified when the unconstrained topology annotation was set to "false". Kueue now rejects this value when the TASRejectFalseUnconstrainedTopology feature gate is enabled. (#15847, @cryo-zd)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where, with the `SchedulerLibraryIntegration` feature gate enabled, ResourceFlavor tolerations and admission-check PodSetUpdates (for example a ProvisioningRequest nodeSelector) were not applied to the simulated pod, so a workload could stay pending on a tainted node or be assigned to a node its nodeSelector excludes. (#15836, @nsega)
- TAS: Introduced the alpha feature gate `TASPartialSlices` (enabled by default) to support scheduling PodSets whose count is not an exact multiple of the slice size. (#16121, @pajakd)
- TrainJob: Fixed a bug where an evicted or unadmitted TrainJob emitted a `Stopped` event and sent a redundant PATCH request on every reconcile. (#15754, @henry3260)
- WorkloadPriorityClassDefaulting: Fixed the defaulting webhook setting the `kueue.x-k8s.io/priority-class: default` label on jobs created in namespaces excluded by `managedJobsNamespaceSelector`. (#15998, @rjgoyln)
- Workloads: Fixed a bug that caused an incorrect pointer value in admission errors when resourceUsage was not divisible by the assigned pod count. Kueue now reports the actual pod count. (#15738, @Kunal241207)
- Workloads: Fixed a bug where a Workload with pod-level requests smaller than its aggregate container requests could reserve too little quota. Kueue now accounts for at least the aggregate container requests and adds Pod overhead. (#16047, @Dasmat13)

### Other (Cleanup or Flake)

- Helm: Set the default Cohort controller concurrency to 1 for Helm installations. (#15876, @HsiuChuanHsu)

### (No, really, you MUST read this before you upgrade)

- Workloads: Fixed a bug that caused Workloads to be finalized as orphaned while their owner Job was being deleted. Kueue now waits until the owner Job no longer exists before finalizing the Workload.
  
  If you implement the ComposableJob interface in a custom job integration, change your Load method to return (*jobframework.LoadResult, error) instead of (bool, error). Use jobframework.NewLoadResult(shouldFinalize, found) where found is false when the job is absent and true otherwise. (#15465, @mbobrovskyi)
 
## Changes by Kind

### Feature

- CLI: The importer mapping file now supports a `resources` list in the `match` block, selecting only the Pods that request a non-zero amount of all the listed resources. (#15663, @Huang-Wei)
- KueueViz: Added `kueueViz.ingress`, an opt-in Helm value that serves the dashboard and its backend from a single host through one path-routed Ingress, (#15673, @HsiuChuanHsu)

### Bug or Regression

- CLI: Aggregate Matching Pods into One PodList for Structured Output (#15520, @weizhoublue)
- CLI: Fix kueuectl ClusterQueue resource-group validation to detect overlaps consistently and preserve distinct resource groups. (#15522, @DevaanshPathak)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `create clusterqueue` silently dropped a `--borrowing-limit` or `--lending-limit` entry for a resource not listed in `--nominal-quota`, and rejected omitting a limit for some nominal-quota resources. Limits are now optional per resource, and a limit for a resource without a nominal quota is reported as an error naming the flag and resource. (#15513, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl create clusterqueue` accepted a resource listed more than once in the same `--nominal-quota`, `--borrowing-limit` or `--lending-limit` flag. The command now rejects the input with an error naming the resource and the flag. (#15519, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl create clusterqueue` rejected a quota flag value with a trailing semicolon, such as `--nominal-quota "alpha:cpu=1;"`, with a misleading `invalid resource quota` error. The trailing semicolon is now accepted, as the flag's format validation already allowed it. (#15517, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed shell completion for  `kueuectl stop workload`  and  `kueuectl resume workload` , which continued suggesting additional Workload names after the single required name was entered, potentially producing commands rejected for too many arguments (#15464, @weizhoublue)
- CLI: Fixed the `--status` flag help text and error message of `kueuectl list workload` to include the supported `quotareserved` value. (#15486, @henry3260)
- ClusterQueue, Cohort & LocalQueue: Fixed a bug where the status was written to the API server on every reconcile even when nothing changed. Kueue now skips the update when the status is unchanged. (#15592, @henry3260)
- ConcurrentAdmission: Fixed a bug where the preemption gate could still be opened for a less favorable Workload Variant while a more favorable one was waiting to be evaluated, when that Variant already carried a `QuotaReserved` condition with reason `PendingEvaluation`. ### Feature

- MultiKueue: Added support for reusing clientConnection configuration (QPS and Burst) for worker clusters via the `MultiKueueReuseClientConnectionConfigForWorkers` Alpha feature gate. (#15280, @alien1403)
- TAS: Added support for PodSet slicing alongside PodSet grouping, allowing workloads such as LeaderWorkerSet to co-locate grouped leader PodSets with sliced worker PodSets. This behavior is gated by the TASGroupedPodSetSlicing feature gate. (#15252, @pajakd)

### Bug or Regression

- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl create clusterqueue` rejected valid decimal quantities such as `cpu=1.5` or `memory=1.5Gi` in `--nominal-quota`, `--borrowing-limit` and `--lending-limit` with `invalid resources specification`. (#15312, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl list workload --clusterqueue` never matched pending Workloads, so combining it with `--status pending` always returned no results. (#15338, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl list workload` could print the JOB TYPE and JOB NAME columns in a random order for Workloads with multiple owner references, such as pod groups. (#15393, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed a bug where `kueuectl list` with `-o yaml` or `-o json` produced invalid output when the result spanned more than one page (`KUEUECTL_LIST_REQUEST_LIMIT`, 100 by default). All pages are now merged into a single document. (#15382, @henry3260)
- CLI: Fixed kueuectl list pods incorrectly treating any output format containing "wide" as -o wide, causing JSONPath and similar expressions to be silently ignored. (#15159, @DevaanshPathak)
- CLI: Fixed shell completion for the `--clusterqueue` and `--localqueue` flags, which returned no suggestions once a positional argument was typed, for example in `kueuectl create localqueue NAME -c <TAB>`. `kueuectl delete workload` completion now also includes inactive Workloads. (#15388, @henry3260)
- DRA: Fixed a bug where deactivating a pending Workload caused Kueue's internal resource adjustments (RuntimeClass overhead, LimitRange defaults, limits-derived requests) to be written back into the user's Workload spec. (#15151, @tomsen02)
- MultiKueue: share one rate limiter across per-worker MultiKueue REST clients. (#15326, @weizhoublue)
- Observability: Fixed a panic that could crash the manager when `CustomMetricLabels` is enabled with a ClusterQueue-sourced label and a Pod's Kueue scheduling gate is removed. (#15391, @mimowo)
- Scheduler: The scheduler now persists NoMatchingFlavor for workloads that request both covered and uncovered resources. (#15314, @PannagaRao)
- StatefulSet: Fixed a bug where scaling a StatefulSet to zero and then back up to a different number of replicas left the Workload with the original pod count, causing it to be admitted and charged quota for the wrong number of pods. (#15302, @sohankunkerkar)
- TAS NodeHotSwap: Fix a bug where workload node replacements are potentially stuck (#15397, @tenzen-y)
- TAS: Fix a bug where RecomputeAssignmentUponPreemptionTargetsOverlap doesn't work correctly when TASHandleOverlappingFlavors is enabled. (#15406, @tenzen-y)
- TAS: Fixed a bug where a completed PodSet in a multi-PodSet workload kept its topology domain occupied, preventing admission of pending workloads that had sufficient quota. This behavior is gated by the ReclaimablePods feature gate. (#15225, @kshalot)
- TrainJob: Fixed a bug where the TrainJob mutating webhook added a duplicate Kueue-owned runtimePatch entry on every update, causing spec.runtimePatches to accumulate stale entries. (#15216, @kannon92)
- TrainJob: Fixed admission dropping runtime-defined tolerations when ResourceFlavor tolerations were applied, which could leave pods Pending on tainted nodes. (#15195, @izturn)
- Workloads: Fixed a bug that could crash the Kueue controller when a namespace-scoped user created a Workload without a controller owner. Kueue now ignores the unrelated Workload. (#15353, @mbobrovskyi)
- Workloads: Fixed a bug where a workload requeued after a backoff period was accounted using its raw spec rather than its effective resources, dropping requests derived from limits, LimitRange defaults, and RuntimeClass overhead. Kueue now correctly accounts the adjusted resources on requeue, preventing ClusterQueue overcommitment. (#15350, @tomsen02)

  Remove or rename those entries before upgrading, or the kueue-controller-manager will fail to start. Renaming a mapping name or an `outputs` key also requires updating the matching ClusterQueue `nominalQuota` entries in the same change. (#14756, @thc1006)
 
## Changes by Kind

### Feature

- WorkloadAwareScheduler: Added the kueue.x-k8s.io/workload annotation to Pods created by Kueue-managed jobs when the SchedulerLibraryIntegration feature gate is enabled; previously only TopologyAwareScheduling added it. (#14796, @Singularity23x0)

### Bug or Regression

- AdmissionChecks: Fix a bug where the Workload has an Admitted=True condition regardless of AdmissionCheck Rejection state. (#14871, @TapanManu)
- AdmissionFairSharing: Fixed preemption ordering for Workloads from same-named LocalQueues in different namespaces so that LocalQueue usage is considered. (#14876, @tomsen02)
- DRA: Fixed config validation silently accepting capacity names with more than one slash, which produced a mapping that never matched any device. (#14953, @NasitSony)
- FairSharing: Fix a bug where Kueue could miss valid preemption targets after selecting workloads from the preemptor's own ClusterQueue and lowering its DRS. The fix is guarded by the Alpha `FairSharingReevaluatePreemptionCandidates` feature gate, which is disabled by default. Enabling the gate may increase exposure to the known fair-sharing preemption-loop issue tracked in #14543. (#14767, @lightZebra)
- Fixed a bug where a prebuilt or externally created Workload could be treated as equivalent to its Job even when the Job's pod template declared pod-level `resources` or `resourceClaims` that the Workload's PodSet omitted, letting the Workload reserve less quota than its Pods actually request. (#15016, @pujitha24)
- Fixed a controller panic triggered by Namespace updates after a ClusterQueue failed to initialize because its Cohort had a cycle. (#14983, @YQ-Wang)
- Helm: Fix a bug where user-defined metricsService labels are not propagated to the rendered manifests. (#15005, @HsiuChuanHsu)

  existing OutOfSync handling. (#15082, @NasitSony)
- MultiKueue: Fixed a bug where the WorkloadPriorityClass controller incorrectly updated the priority of MultiKueue remote workloads when a WorkloadPriorityClass value changed. Remote workloads are now skipped during priority synchronization. (#14995, @weizhoublue)
- MultiKueue: Fixed stale observedGeneration on the AdmissionCheckActive condition after updating to a MultiKueueConfig that preserves the cluster health result. (#14915, @cryo-zd)
- MultiKueue: Truncate quota automation condition messages so unsupported manager/worker resource configurations can be reported successfully. (#14989, @cryo-zd)
- Observability: Fixed `kueue_pod_scheduling_gate_removal_seconds` observing negative durations when the controller clock trails the apiserver clock. The negative observations made the histogram's `_sum` decrease, which broke `rate()` over that series. (#14731, @Antrikshgwal)
- Observability: Scheduling hash re-computations are now logged at V5 via the contextual logger. (#15060, @apullo777)
- Pending Workloads rejected by a LimitRange are requeued when the LimitRange's max, min, or maxLimitRequestRatio change, or the LimitRange is deleted. (#15029, @tomsen02)
- Pod: Fixed a bug where a serving pod group's evicted pod could be left stuck in `Terminating` forever, since its `kueue.x-k8s.io/managed` finalizer was only removed for a Workload deletion, not for other evictions (e.g. a `recoveryTimeout` eviction). This could cause a legitimate replacement pod to be deleted as excess instead, or permanently block a same-name (StatefulSet-owned) replacement from ever being created. Kueue now removes the finalizer as soon as an evicted pod has actually terminated. (#14793, @mszadkow)
- ProvisioningRequest: Fixed a bug where the `Active` condition's `observedGeneration` on a ProvisioningRequest AdmissionCheck was not updated when a configuration change kept the check healthy, leaving `observedGeneration` permanently behind `metadata.generation`. (#14934, @weizhoublue)
- RayService: Fixed a bug where elastic (autoscaling) RayService pods could stay stuck in `SchedulingGated` on `kueue.x-k8s.io/elastic-job` after the origin workload slice was deleted, leaving the RayCluster below its desired replica count. (#15103, @kevin85421)
- Scheduling: Fix a bug in BestEffortFIFO where a workload with failed preemption could remain sticky at the queue head. (#15089, @tenzen-y)
- Scheduling: Fix workloads becoming stranded after scheduling snapshot failures, and stale pending accounting when a LocalQueue moves to another ClusterQueue. (#13885, @apullo777)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where Workloads differing only in PodSet names formed separate equivalence classes, so BestEffortFIFO queues re-evaluated each one individually and admission slowed on busy clusters. Controlled by the alpha `SchedulingEquivalenceHashingIgnorePodSetName` feature gate, disabled by default. When enabled, Workloads differing only in PodSet names share a scheduling equivalence class, so BestEffortFIFO queues stop re-evaluating each one individually. Requires `SchedulingEquivalenceHashing`. (#14804, @venuchitta)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where a Workload deactivated with a derived `DeactivatedDueTo<Cause>` reason (such as `DeactivatedDueToRequeuingLimitExceeded`) could remain stuck after reactivation because its `WorkloadRequeued` condition was not transitioned. Such Workloads are now reactivated correctly. (#14879, @adibmbrk)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug where requeueing a Workload recomputed its scheduling equivalence hash even when neither the Workload nor its effective resource requests had changed, adding avoidable CPU and allocation overhead on the scheduler's requeue path. (#14958, @apullo777)
- Scheduling: Fixed a bug which would charge the quota based on the LimitRange (if specified) for workloads
  with only limits specified. That could create a mismatch between the charged quota and the resources actually
  used by the running Pods. (#15039, @tomsen02)
- SparkApplication: Fixed a bug where workloads using dynamic allocation could remain unready after executor scale-down. Workloads are now considered ready when the configured minimum number of executors is running. (#14984, @zhengchenyu)
- TrainJob: Fix a bug where TrainJobs are stuck by using merge patches, instead of Updates, when admitting
  or stopping TrainJobs, thus preserving the fields not represented in Kueue's vendored Trainer API. (#14842, @robert-bell)
- WorkloadPriorityClass: Fixed a bug where a Workload that had reserved quota was repeatedly written with
  a priorityClassRef the API server rejects, when its owner's WorkloadPriorityClass label was removed. (#15008, @tenzen-y)
- WorkloadPriorityClass: Fixed the WorkloadPriorityClass controller to update workloads referencing a changed class through a bounded, cancellable worker pool instead of a serial, uninterruptible loop, and to report a single update error instead of one per failed workload. (#14945, @pujitha24)
